RISKS: Circular-financing/OpenAI lease-guarantee scrutiny could pressure the multiple; hot July PCE (3.7%) keeps rate pressure on high-multiple tech; AI capex digestion or order cancellations; China export restrictions; AMD/custom-silicon competition; post-earnings volatility (volume was 2.56x average on 8/27).
